title: Elevated 5xx errors on auth-svc
impact: A share of requests failed with 5xx on auth-svc
symptom: [ANOMALY] auth-svc 2026-05-04 08:25-12:45: auth-svc: 287 of 368 log lines were non-INFO between 2026-05-04 08:25 and 2026-05-04 12:45 UTC (peak error ratio 0.93 vs baseline median 0.0). 3 error templates, 2 first seen in this span.
error_templates: ECS service started 1 task (replacing a stopped task)
ECS task stopped: OutOfMemoryError: Container killed due to memory usage

_templates.macro: Terraform change halved {svc} task memory {old} -> {new} MB; tasks were OOM-killed under load and the service restarted in a loop.
_templates.remediation: Restore memory = {old} on {resource}; alarm on MemoryUtilization.

culprit.diff:
@@ -95,3 +95,3 @@ aws_ecs_task_definition.auth_svc
 resource "aws_ecs_task_definition" "auth_svc" {
-  memory = 2048
+  memory = 1024
   tags = local.tags

rca.macro: Terraform change halved auth-svc task memory 2048 -> 1024 MB; tasks were OOM-killed under load and the service restarted in a loop.
rca.remediation: Restore memory = 2048 on aws_ecs_task_definition.auth_svc; alarm on MemoryUtilization.

action_items: Require a reviewed `terraform plan` and a CloudWatch alarm for the changed AWS resource.
Alert on the error signature `ECS service started 1 task (replacing a stopped task)`.
